core_result: For symmetric A=A0+R with A0R=0 and original-coordinate cut I,J, writing C=A[I,I], M=A[I,J], one has s_p(C)^2+s_q(M)^2 >= lambda_k((A0^2)[I,I]) whenever p+q=k+1. Consequently arbitrary remaining eigenvalues of either sign and magnitude can only transfer a protected spectral-square carrier between self and cross blocks.
diffuse_splitter: For three selected |lambda|>=1 eigenvectors with max row leverage <=1/256, a balanced original-coordinate cut exists. At a=1/(2sqrt(2)), if q is the number of cross singular values >=a, each self block has at least 3-q singular values >=a. If q>=3 and final cross-range leverage <=1/2, the current fractional-volume theorem gives continuous density <64.
partner_result_applied: account04/B12 complementary-Schur shield at math-open-problems@3948d77b0bde5af1bd37cd7c975d4f540eba901b. Its gamma_p=ell(rho)^2 mu is inserted into the profile theorem, yielding s1(C)^2+s3(M)^2, s2(C)^2+s2(M)^2, s3(C)^2+s1(M)^2 >= gamma_p^2 after arbitrary orthogonal spectral completion.
volume_result_applied: math-open-problems@c2414ef633b9d4b7f04a83e1aeefbe713ed82bba. With cross s3>=1/(2sqrt2) and max range leverage <=1/2, continuous density <=48sqrt(6)e/5<64.
checks: 10,000 random spectral completions, 28,738 profile inequalities, zero violations; 5,000 Bernoulli cuts for a 1024x3 Hadamard frame all met the 1/4 Gram deviation gate. Checks are non-proof sanity tests.
unresolved_implication: Close high-leverage row/cross-range survivors and mixed q=1,2 self/cross receivers without losing original-coordinate product structure; q=0 cannot be discharged circularly by reusing the conjecture on a large self block.
next_step: Prove a mixed receiver combining r=1 or 2 strong self singular directions with 3-r strong cross directions at a common universal scale, including arbitrary within-bank curvature and affine terms, then integrate the hub/high-leverage exits.
